purpose: Controlled Wan open-source UGC prompt matrix for ISDIN FusionWater Magic with Lia brunette identity, Mara redhead full-body motion reference, product-safe claims, ElevenLabs voice, and later lipsync.

product.name: ISDIN Fotoprotector FusionWater Magic SPF 50
product.prompt: The product is a small light blue ISDIN Fotoprotector FusionWater Magic SPF 50 sunscreen bottle with a translucent cap. Use the provided product reference for shape and color. Do not invent or redraw label text. If the label becomes warped, keep the product as a separate packshot or edit overlay instead of relying on generated text.
product.claim_safety: Internal visual demo only. Do not claim medical results, dermatology endorsement, waterproof performance, acne benefits, anti-aging benefits, or guaranteed protection. It is acceptable to visually show the bottle and say this is a demo/product presentation.

identity_lock.full_body_reference_warning: Current approved close-up face is Lia, the brunette model. Existing full-body bank is Mara, the red-haired model. Use Mara only for pose/motion tests until a Lia brunette full-body still is approved.
identity_lock.fixed_prompt: Use the input image as the identity source. Preserve the same fictional adult brunette UGC model: oval face, warm light skin, natural freckles, brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, straight natural nose, full pink lips, soft warm smile, shoulder-length wavy brown hair with subtle highlights, natural skin texture, white or cream outfit, clean bright room lighting.
identity_lock.negative_prompt: different person, changed face, changed eyes, changed eyebrows, changed nose, changed lips, changed smile, changed hair, changed age, red hair in brunette route, plastic skin, beauty filter, warped mouth, distorted teeth, blurry face, face flicker, cartoon, anime, fake logo, fake label text, text artifacts, watermark, scene change, background transformation

batch_rules.first_batch_recipe: 6 talking-head silent source clips, 6 product-demo medium clips, 6 full-body motion-reference clips only after the correct input image is uploaded.
batch_rules.do_not_scale_until: At least one clip in each required shot type scores identity>=4, artifacts>=4, product_safety>=4, and ugc_use>=4.

routes.label: Wan2.2 TI2V 5B - talking-head source
routes.use_for: silent identity-stable clips that can later receive ElevenLabs audio and lipsync

routes.label: Wan2.2 S2V 14B - lipsync candidate
routes.use_for: audio-driven talking video after the S2V checkpoint is installed
routes.avoid: running until the missing S2V model is installed and a short smoke test passes

tones.prompt: calm, polished, trustworthy, premium skincare energy

visual_styles.label: Medium product demo
visual_styles.prompt: medium UGC product demo, face and upper torso visible, product may be held near chest but label does not need to be readable

visual_styles.prompt: close product cutaway for editing, clean white surface, hand places bottle down, label should come from source overlay if needed

settings.prompt: bright clean bathroom or vanity corner, soft daylight, white tile, skincare routine mood

settings.label: Warm apartment
settings.prompt: warm modern apartment, neutral sofa, curtains, plant, soft daylight, lived-in UGC

settings.prompt: clean desk review setup, laptop edge out of focus, notebook, soft daylight, no readable screens

motions.label: Silent mouth-neutral source
motions.prompt: subtle breathing, one blink, tiny head nod, lips stay almost closed and neutral, no actual speech yet

motions.prompt: raises the product gently to chest level, holds it steady for one second, then lowers it slightly; hands remain natural

motions.label: Apply on hand

motions.label: Stand and small step
motions.prompt: starts standing full body, takes one small natural step toward camera, stops, shifts weight, lifts product slightly, no fast walking

motions.label: Look down and up
motions.prompt: looks briefly at the product, then back to camera, one natural blink, small smile

hooks.label: No fake review
hooks.text: No voy a fingir que esto es una resena real; te muestro como se veria el producto en una pieza UGC.

hooks.label: Texture hook
hooks.text: Antes de vender skincare en redes, primero necesitas que la textura y la luz se entiendan.

hooks.label: Simple demo
hooks.text: Este es el tipo de toma simple que hace que un producto deje de verse como foto de catalogo.

hooks.label: Visual ad test
hooks.text: Estamos probando una version UGC para ver si el producto se siente mas real en video.

spoken_texts.label: Demo safe 12s
spoken_texts.text: No voy a fingir que esto es una resena real. La idea es mostrar el producto con una toma limpia, luz natural y un movimiento que se sienta de redes.

spoken_texts.label: Skincare visual 15s
spoken_texts.text: Para vender un producto de skincare no siempre necesitas una produccion enorme. Necesitas que la textura, la luz y el uso se entiendan rapido.

spoken_texts.label: Product clarity 15s
spoken_texts.text: Lo que estamos probando aqui es simple: que el producto se vea claro, que la persona se vea real y que el video no parezca un anuncio falso.

spoken_texts.label: Client offer 20s
spoken_texts.text: Si tienes una tienda y tus productos se ven planos en redes, podemos crear piezas UGC con modelo IA. Primero validamos estilo y despues hacemos las versiones finales.

spoken_texts.label: CTA demo 12s
spoken_texts.text: Esta es solo una prueba visual. Si funciona, la siguiente version lleva voz, subtitulos y cortes listos para anuncio.

prompt_templates.wan22_ugc_product_motion: {identity_lock} {product_prompt} {product_claim_safety} Create a silent vertical 9:16 ultra-realistic UGC skincare video. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting: {setting}. Outfit: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. Tone: {tone}. Hook intent: "{hook}". The final spoken text will be added later with ElevenLabs and lipsync: "{spoken_text}". Keep face identity stable and sharp for the whole clip. Keep hands realistic and slow. Keep product shape and color believable. No subtitles, no text overlays, no watermark, no fake label text, no medical claims, no fake testimonial, no exaggerated speech mouth.
prompt_templates.wan22_product_cutaway_from_packshot: Use the input image as the exact product source. The product is a light blue ISDIN Fotoprotector FusionWater Magic SPF 50 sunscreen bottle with a translucent cap. Create a silent vertical 9:16 product cutaway for a skincare UGC edit. Place the same bottle on a clean bright bathroom vanity or white surface, soft daylight, premium but natural phone-camera realism. Motion: the camera makes a very small handheld push-in and a hand may gently place or steady the bottle, but the bottle shape must remain recognizable. Do not create a person in this shot. Do not invent new readable label text; preserve the original product look as much as possible. No subtitles, no watermark, no medical claims, no extra brands.
prompt_templates.wan22_full_body_motion_test: {identity_lock} {product_prompt} Use the input image as the body and pose source. Create a silent vertical 9:16 full-body UGC movement test. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting: {setting}. Outfit: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. Keep the whole body visible from head to shoes at the start. Movement must include legs, hips, shoulders, arms, head, and natural weight shift, not only face movement. Product may be held at chest level, but do not try to recreate label text. No speech mouth, no sudden camera zoom, no warped legs, no broken fingers, no scene change.
prompt_templates.wan22_lipsync_source: {identity_lock} {product_prompt} Create a short vertical 9:16 talking-head source video prepared for audio-driven lipsync. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting: {setting}. Outfit: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. The line to sync later is: "{spoken_text}". Keep head and shoulders steady, face centered, mouth neutral and realistic, eyes sharp, no big gestures. No text, no subtitles, no watermark, no fake label text.
prompt_templates.positive: {identity_lock} {product_prompt} UGC test. Visual style: {visual_style}. Setting: {setting}. Outfit: {outfit}. Motion: {motion}. Tone: {tone}. Hook: "{hook}". Spoken text for later audio: "{spoken_text}".
prompt_templates.negative: {negative_prompt}. Also avoid: full-body from a face-only source, static photo only, frozen body, broken walking, deformed legs, deformed hands, extra fingers, floating product, product label hallucination, fake testimonial, medical claim, guaranteed result, unreadable text artifacts, third-party logos beyond the provided product, copied creator style.
prompt_templates.elevenlabs_direction: Spanish LATAM, young adult woman, natural UGC delivery, {tone}. Pace should fit {duration_seconds}s. Use the exact spoken text. Do not sound like a TV announcer. Leave a short pause after the hook.

hard_fails: full-body clip starts from face-only source and invents a body
product label becomes fake readable text
clip implies a real testimonial or medical guarantee

recommended_sequence: Approve or generate one Lia brunette full-body still holding/near ISDIN.
Run 6 Wan TI2V silent full-body movement tests from that still.
Run 6 Wan TI2V medium talking-head source clips from the Lia brunette close-up still.
Generate exact ElevenLabs audio for the chosen script.
Apply Wan S2V or InfiniteTalk lipsync to the selected medium talking-head clip.
Edit final UGC with full-body B-roll, medium lipsync, product cutaway, captions, and product overlay if label warps.
production_route.reason: Asking one open-source video model to solve identity, full-body walking, product label, exact audio, and lipsync in one clip is the highest-risk route. Shot-based production is faster and more reliable.
